settings.heading_line1: A normal cover just drapes over the bench.
settings.heading_line2: Your dog still slides into the footwell.
settings.body: RoadNest drops a padded panel into that gap and turns the whole back seat into one flat bed.

settings.title: The footwell is the actual problem.
settings.text: A cover that drapes over the bench leaves the gap in front of it open. That is where a dog slides on a hard stop, and where an older or bigger dog struggles to get comfortable in the first place.

settings.title: Waterproof usually means sprayed on.
settings.text: Most covers in this price range use a surface coating that stops working after a month of wet dogs. Ours is a bonded inner layer — it is part of the fabric, not painted onto it.

settings.title: Covered does not have to mean boxed in.
settings.text: Hammock covers put a wall between your dog and the rest of the car. Mesh side windows keep the air moving and let your dog see out, and let you see your dog.

settings.title: What it is not.
settings.text: It is not a crash-tested restraint, and we will not pretend otherwise. It protects your interior and gives your dog a flat surface to lie on. For crash protection you want a proper harness or a crate.
